summary: @elliquinn Correct., but does it have to be that way? I stay on Twitter because it is the network of connected teachers. Yet I also try to do it from my websites first, but work hard to share the values of open pedagogy more than a specific technical solution.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @elliquinn Correct., but does it have to be that way? I stay on Twitter because it is the network of connected teachers. Yet I also try to do it from my websites first, but work hard to share the values of open pedagogy more than a specific technical solution.
